resources.string:
"Re:TUI V.5 turns IRC into a full client for any network, lets you open your dock modules from Search and Terminal mode, and adds recent, newest and most-used views to the app drawer.

## IRC, rebuilt

The old Re:TUI chat server is retired. The IRC pane now connects to real IRC networks.

- Pick Libera.Chat, OFTC, Rizon or hackint, or add any server that supports TLS. Connect to several networks at once.
- Channels open side by side in a Termux-style split view. Tap a pane to start typing in it.
- Dropped connections reconnect by themselves and rejoin your channels. They also reconnect as soon as your phone is back online.
- Sign in with your account once, and Re:TUI can remember this phone with a device key, so you don't need the password next time. Where a network has no SASL, sign-in goes through NickServ.
- If your nickname is taken, Re:TUI tries a variant instead of failing. When sign-in fails, the pane says why, such as a wrong password or an unverified account.
- **Stay connected:** turn it on in the Networks page or with `/background on`. Your networks stay online after you close the pane, with an ongoing notification and a Disconnect button. Private messages and mentions of your nickname arrive as notifications; tap one to open that conversation.

## Modules in Search and Terminal mode

- Search results have a new **MODULES** group that lists your dock modules.
- Tap one to open it right under the chips. The wallpaper blurs behind it, and the search bar and other results stay where they are.
- Swipe sideways or tap another chip to switch modules. Tap the open chip, X or Back to close the module and return to your search.

## Apps

- `apps -r` opens the app drawer with your recently opened apps first, `apps -n` with the newest installed and `apps -u` with the most used. Tap the header to go back to A–Z.
- The `apps` suggestion chips now lead with the views you use most.

## Output pane

- The output pane always keeps at least three lines, even when modules fill the screen.
- When the output pane is collapsed, a ! on the OUTPUT tab shows that something new arrived.

## Weather

- `%name` shows your location again.
- New placeholders for `weather_format`: `%temp_min` and `%temp_max` for the next 24 hours, and `%rain` for the rain expected in the next hour.

## Fixes

- Changes to alias.txt apply as soon as you save, without `restart`.
- `-tutorial` on every command opens the right guide.
- In Search and Terminal mode, the app drawer no longer closes on its own, Back closes open panes in Terminal mode, and `clear` also clears the results card.

Reopen these notes anytime with the `changelog` command."
